run_hanabi_game: run a Hanabi game with TorchBot and SearchBot using hanabi_lib
start_game: start a new Hanabi game with a bot name and random seed
wait_for_my_turn: wait until the bot's turn by polling server.activePlayer
make_move: make a hint or discard move using Move and MoveType enums
end_game: end the Hanabi game and clean up resources on the C side
